name: Can I get a metal roof consultation if my current roof is not metal?

mainEntity.name: Can I get a metal roof consultation if my current roof is not metal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. Many homeowners consult us about replacing their asphalt shingles or other roofing materials with a new metal roof. During the consultation, our team will assess the condition of your existing roof and its substructure to ensure it can support a metal roofing system. We'll outline any necessary preparation or modifications, such as reinforcement, that might be required before installing the new metal roof, providing a complete project overview.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can get a metal roof consultation even with a non-metal roof; we assess the existing structure for metal roof compatibility and any required modifications.
